scope: Final academic disposition of every remaining unscored, non-reference publisher exercise without reopening locked pages.
policy: A source exercise may remain preserved but must not become scored practice unless its recovered bilingual record yields one defensible response. Holds are a completed review outcome, not missing practice content.

items.finding: The Constitution does not create the ordinary ministerial rank hierarchy used by the options. 'All ministers are equal' may describe constitutional membership/status but not every protocol or functional distinction, while option 3 has no clear grammatical subject in the recovered wording.
items.why_not_repair: Rewriting the stem or options would create a new author question rather than faithfully score the publisher exercise.

items.finding: 'Supreme decision-making authority' is undefined. The President is the formal constitutional executive, the Prime Minister supplies political leadership, and the Council/Cabinet exercises collective executive decision-making; the stem does not identify the intended dimension.
items.why_not_repair: Selecting the printed President key would teach an unqualified personal-executive model inconsistent with Articles 74-75.

items.finding: More than one listed Prime Minister led a coalition or coalition-supported arrangement; the singular stem provides no date, coalition definition or differentiating condition.
items.why_not_repair: No evidence supports narrowing the historical period or intended coalition definition.

items.finding: The Prime Minister's death ends the existing ministry, and a ministry under the new leader must then be constituted/sworn. Options 1 and 3 describe immediate and ensuing consequences rather than mutually exclusive propositions.
items.why_not_repair: The printed and study keys select different temporal layers; a single-answer score would overstate certainty.

items.finding: The current recovered option set makes 'all of the above' academically defensible, but the saved review history records that the source printed Indira Gandhi as the keyed option. That discrepancy indicates an unresolved source/options transcription conflict.
items.why_not_repair: The locked page cannot be reopened to determine whether the current option record or earlier key-description is wrong.

items.finding: Direct election is a composition feature, collective responsibility is an accountability rule, and Lok Sabha has financial predominance rather than exclusive control over every budget matter. Calling all three 'special powers' makes option 4 academically unsafe.
items.why_not_repair: A valid replacement would require a materially new stem and qualified options.
